title: New users, take a look! Complete tutorial on registration, login, and trial use on the CLO China official website
description: Attention new CLO users! Official CLO guide on how to register a new account on the Chinese official website — login — full process for free trial version.
transcript:
3w.clo3d-china.com  
First, open our Chinese official website, 3w.clo3d-china.com.  
Because mobile phones and WeChat browsers tend to lose the page easily, it is recommended to use a computer to open it.  
Recommended browsers include iChrome and other mainstream browsers.  
Click the login button, then click the login button on the login page.  
Enter your email, password, and mobile phone number.  
After receiving the mobile phone verification code, click Verify.  
Click Create Account and verify your identity as a real person.  
Next, please check your registered email to receive the verification email.  
Congratulations, you have successfully registered your account.  
You can click the upper right corner of the website to check your account details.  
If you no longer wish to use the following, you may sign up.  
Thank you.  
If you want to sign up for the free trial, please click the blue Free Application button.  
Click Download and start the free trial for 14 days.  
The latest version of the software will be downloaded automatically.  
After downloading the software, double-click to install it.  
Click the Download button to install the software.  
After installation is complete, you will see a blue software icon on the desktop.  
Double-click to open it and click the black login button.  
On the login page that appears, please click the Chinese user login button.  
Since you have already logged in to the Chinese official website, you can log in directly as shown in the video.  
If you need to log in again, simply enter your email address and password.  
Enjoy your design journey!

chunks.title: New users, take a look! Complete tutorial on registration, login, and trial use on the CLO China official website
chunks.content: ## Accessing the CLO China Official Website and Account Registration This section explains how to access the CLO China official website, recommended browsers, and the step-by-step process for creating a user account, including email and mobile phone verification. 1. Open the official CLO China website at [3w.clo3d-china.com](http://3w.clo3d-china.com) using a computer for optimal stability, as mobile phones and WeChat browsers may lose the page easily. 2. Use mainstream browsers such as iChrome for the best experience. 3. Click the **Login** button on the homepage, then again on the login page. 4. Enter your email address, password, and mobile phone number. 5. After receiving a verification code on your mobile phone, enter it and click **Verify**. 6. Click **Create Account** and complete the real-person identity verification process. 7. Check your registered email inbox for a verification email and follow the instructions to verify your email address. 8. Upon successful verification, your account registration is complete. 9. You can view your account details by clicking the account icon in the upper right corner of the website. ## Starting a Free Trial and Software Installation This section covers how to apply for the free trial, download, install, and log in to the CLO software on your computer. 1. To start a free trial, click the blue **Free Application** button on the website. 2. Click **Download** to begin downloading the latest version of the CLO software. The download process is automatic. 3. After the download completes, double-click the installer file to begin installation. 4. Follow the on-screen prompts and click **Download** or **Install** as needed during the process. 5. Once installed, a blue CLO software icon will appear on your desktop. 6. Double-click the icon to open the software. 7. On the software's login page, select the **Chinese User Login** button. 8. Since you have already logged in on the CLO China website, you can log in directly within the software. 9. If you are prompted to log in again, enter your registered email address and password. 10. After logging in, you can start using the software and enjoy your design journey. --- This document provides detailed instructions on registration, verification, software download, installation, and login procedures specifically for new users on the CLO China official website.
